detail.sql: SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.title, m.topic, m.review_status, m.priority, m.updated_at FROM study_materials m JOIN ai_study_sets a ON a.source_material_id = m.id WHERE a.flashcards_json IS NOT NULL AND a.flashcards_json != '[]' AND a.flashcards_json != '' ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.priority = 'next_up' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, m.updated_at DESC, m.id ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT e.id, e.item_id, e.generation, e.rating, e.reviewed_at, e.scheduler_version, e.prior_state_json, e.next_state_json, i.ordinal, i.front, i.back, i.source_page, v.id AS version_id, v.content_hash, v.created_at AS version_created_at, v.source_material_id AS material_id, m.title AS material_title FROM card_review_events e JOIN card_items i ON i.id = e.item_id JOIN card_versions v ON v.id = i.version_id JOIN study_materials m ON m.id = v.source_material_id ORDER BY e.reviewed_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT ?
SELECT source_material_id, flashcards_json FROM ai_study_sets WHERE source_material_id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
